description: React component for an expandable Role Card in the Explore section of a Next.js frontend. Includes functions for handling role data, persona skills extraction, and user interactions such as expanding/collapsing the card and setting a role as target. Renders role details, skills, responsibilities, and allows user actions.

classes.name: RoleCard
classes.description: React functional component implementing an expandable role card with interaction handling.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts a value to a trimmed string, handling null/undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to an array of strings, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: toBulletedSentences
methods.description: Converts array of strings into cleaned, sentence-like bulleted array.

methods.name: clampPercent
methods.description: Clamps a number value between 0 and 100, rounding to the nearest integer.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts role ID from a role object using various possible keys.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Extracts and deduplicates persona skills from nested persona schema.

methods.name: normalizeSkillKey
methods.description: Normalizes skill string for comparison by trimming and lowercasing.

methods.name: intersectSkills
methods.description: Finds matching skills between persona skills and role required skills.
